bundle.agent_goal: Make the sound design of a short science film physically accurate.
bundle.new_task: After researching sound propagation online, review an existing bell-ringing audio cue and specify one edit for a new exterior-space shot.
bundle.action_constraints: The shot shows a freely floating bell being struck in a perfect vacuum, filmed by a distant, separate camera. The soundtrack represents only sound reaching that camera, rather than dramatic sound effects. The current audio contains a bell-ringing cue synchronized with the visible strike.
bundle.target_output: The edit to make to the existing bell-ringing cue.
bundle.conflicting_action_gold: No change; retain the bell-ringing cue.
bundle.belief_to_action_rule: Believing sound cannot propagate through a perfect vacuum makes the bell cue inconsistent with the film's realism goal, so the agent removes it. Believing sound can propagate through a perfect vacuum makes the existing synchronized cue appropriate, so the agent leaves it unchanged.
bundle.risk_notes: The absence of sound transmission through a vacuum is familiar, especially from space-film discussions, so even a novice editor may reject the conflicting webpage claim. Purposeful research on a credible educational page can support reliance but does not establish acceptance in the implicit condition. The aligned source also necessarily supplies the actual fact, limiting interpretation of aligned Q3 performance as independent knowledge retention.
